name: Rclone
description: Docker for Rclone - a command line program to sync files and directories to and from various cloud services.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: The path to where the .rclone.conf file is

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: The path to the data which should be backed up by Rclone

variables.name: Sync Destination
variables.description: The destination that the data should be backed up to (must be the same name as specified in .rclone.conf)

variables.name: Sync Destination Subpath
variables.description: If the data should be backed up to a subpath on the destionation (will automaticly be created if it does not exist)

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: A custom cron schedule which will override the default value of: 0 * * * * (hourly)

variables.name: Sync Command
variables.description: A custom rclone command which will override the default value of: rclone sync /data $SYNC_DESTINATION:/$SYNC_DESTINATION_SUBPATH
